_comment: Nathaniel Labs hub catalog. Fields per app: repo (drives last-updated date), native[] (hub asset per platform; optional label distinguishes two builds of the same platform), web (live app url, always clickable), ios ('soon'|'live'), ios_url (TestFlight/App Store when live), site (sales/landing page when one exists), access ('public' = anyone may use/share it, 'team' = internal only, never share), blurb (one-line description). Downloadable apps are shown first; iOS apps are labeled + colored distinctly. Two apps may share one repo (e.g. Shruti + Sangam) — each still gets its own card.

apps.name: Baithak
apps.blurb: NSM's own Riverside: remote podcast and music-class studio where every guest's camera and mic record a local master (1080p/4K video + 48 kHz 24-bit stereo WAV) that survives bad internet, plus branded YouTube Live scenes.

apps.name: Net Sense
apps.blurb: Watches every internet line and access point in the studio, proves which provider is at fault, and reads the Wi-Fi around you. Native Mac app.

apps.name: NSM Cut Studio
apps.blurb: Cuts a promo by cutting the words. Syncs camera to recorder, writes out every word you said, and removes the repeats, fillers and throat clears before you even open it. Delete a word, lose it from the video. Native Mac app.

apps.name: NSM Flow
apps.blurb: Free local voice typing for email, WhatsApp, prompts, Indian names and musician-grade chord symbols. Public alpha for Mac and Windows.

apps.name: Shruti
apps.blurb: Per-app volume, EQ and output control for Mac. Official page has the latest installer and update feed.

apps.name: Sangat
apps.blurb: The musician who listens. Always on in the menu bar: it tells you the honest tempo, the key and the raga of whatever you play or sing, remembers every idea, charts it, clicks along with you and hands the night to REAPER.

apps.name: Sangam
apps.blurb: Per-app audio routing engine for the studio — latency-locked sends into REAPER. Internal release candidate.

apps.name: Chorale
apps.blurb: Sing one line, hear a choir - real-time vocal harmonizer with key-aware harmony, pro auto-tune and camera gesture control. Standalone, AU and VST3.

apps.name: GrabIt
apps.blurb: Native Mac video downloader — paste a link, get the file.

apps.name: NSM Stage Bridge
apps.blurb: One stage-safe MIDI bridge for 12 Step2, AirTurn, Korg nanoKONTROL Studio and GeoShred, with one dependable virtual source for MainStage and REAPER.

apps.name: NSM Social Command Centre
apps.blurb: The social planning console + content calendar, in the browser or as a Mac app.

apps.name: Nathaniel Photo Hub
apps.blurb: NSM Photos — the team photo library + Design Studio as a Mac app. Signed & notarized; opens the hub signed-in after a one-time login.

apps.name: Chart Studio
apps.blurb: Jason's handwritten gig charts, digitised — transpose to any key or instrument, play sections on real piano, edit by voice or Apple Pencil. Single-file app, works offline.

apps.name: Trumpet Transposer
apps.blurb: Handwritten concert-pitch exercise sheets redrawn for B♭ trumpet — same engine as Chart Studio. Single-file app, works offline.

apps.name: Hexatonic
apps.blurb: The six-note scale laboratory — explore hexatonic scales and generate melodic groupings against any tala.

apps.name: Prima Vista
apps.blurb: Sight-singing trainer — real-time pitch and rhythm scoring on real notation, with SATB hymns and a circle-of-fifths key wheel.

apps.name: GRADUS
apps.blurb: Fux species counterpoint, taught interactively — the Weave solver finds every valid counterpoint for an exercise.

apps.name: Master Key
apps.blurb: The diminished-seventh laboratory — hear how one dim7 chord unlocks every key on the Key Ring.

apps.name: Rhythm Arithmetic
apps.blurb: Binary-rhythm practice — build bars from note-value arithmetic and clap them back.

apps.name: Atlas
apps.blurb: Instrument science, beginner-first — how every instrument really works, with a tuner and a math lab.

apps.name: Runway
apps.blurb: Improvisation trainer — practice runs, fills and licks that land, over seven playback feels.

apps.name: Read — Sight-Reading
apps.blurb: Sight-reading companion built on Bach's Well-Tempered Clavier — a fresh passage every session.

apps.name: Maatu
apps.blurb: Learn spoken Kannada, Hindi and Tamil — a 16-lesson course with real audio.
